tools.name: tokenledger_report
tools.description: Compute the cost-structure report for a JSONL LLM request log: totals, cache-read share, priming share, conversation share, prefix sizes, steps per turn. Read-only. Returns the same object as `tokenledger report LOGFILE --json`. Call it directly: the log file is in the working directory, so never ask the user to paste it and never guess numbers. Only `logfile` is required for a native log; for Anthropic/OpenAI usage logs also pass format (and turn_key/step_key if the records carry `turn`/`step`). Read total_input, total_cache_read, n_turns from the result and quote them as plain digits (61700, not 61,700). A bad log returns isError with {error:{code,message,hint}}: quote `code` exactly (e.g. TL_E_MISSING_FIELD). Examples: {"logfile":"log.jsonl"}; {"logfile":"oa.jsonl","format":"openai","turn_key":"turn","step_key":"step"}; {"logfile":"usage.jsonl","format":"anthropic"}.

logfile.description: Path to the JSONL log (relative to the working directory).

format.description: Log format: native tokenledger fields, or Anthropic/OpenAI usage records.

turn_key.description: Record field naming the turn (provider formats only).

step_key.description: Record field naming the step (provider formats only).

usage_key.description: Record field holding the usage object (provider formats only).

tools.name: tokenledger_what_if
tools.description: Estimate input tokens saved by removing one step (turn, step) from a log: its own input plus its tool result re-carried into every later step of that turn. Read-only. Returns {turn, step, tokens_saved}. The log file is in the working directory; call the tool directly. Example: {"logfile":"log.jsonl","turn":1,"step":0}.

logfile.description: Path to the JSONL log (relative to the working directory).

turn.description: Turn number as it appears in the log.

turn_key.description: Record field naming the turn (provider formats only).

step_key.description: Record field naming the step (provider formats only).

usage_key.description: Record field holding the usage object (provider formats only).

help.main:
usage: tokenledger [-h] {report,what-if,describe,mcp} ...

Measure the cost structure of multi-agent LLM systems from request logs.

positional arguments:
  {report,what-if,describe,mcp}
    report              print a cost-structure report for a JSONL log
    what-if             input tokens saved by removing one (turn, step)
    describe            print tool definitions (Anthropic, OpenAI, MCP) as
                        JSON
    mcp                 run an MCP server on stdio exposing the tools

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
help.report:
usage: tokenledger report [-h] [--json] [--quiet]
                          [--format {native,anthropic,openai}]
                          [--turn-key TURN_KEY] [--step-key STEP_KEY]
                          [--usage-key USAGE_KEY]
                          logfile

positional arguments:
  logfile               path to a JSONL request log

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                emit JSON instead of text
  --quiet               compact output (one line / minimal JSON)
  --format {native,anthropic,openai}
                        log format: 'native' tokenledger fields (default), or
                        a provider usage log
  --turn-key TURN_KEY   record field naming the turn (provider formats)
  --step-key STEP_KEY   record field naming the step (provider formats)
  --usage-key USAGE_KEY
                        record field holding the usage sub-object (default:
                        'usage' if present, else top level)
help.what-if:
usage: tokenledger what-if [-h] [--json] [--quiet]
                           [--format {native,anthropic,openai}]
                           [--turn-key TURN_KEY] [--step-key STEP_KEY]
                           [--usage-key USAGE_KEY] --turn TURN --step STEP
                           logfile

positional arguments:
  logfile               path to a JSONL request log

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                emit JSON instead of text
  --quiet               compact output (one line / minimal JSON)
  --format {native,anthropic,openai}
                        log format: 'native' tokenledger fields (default), or
                        a provider usage log
  --turn-key TURN_KEY   record field naming the turn (provider formats)
  --step-key STEP_KEY   record field naming the step (provider formats)
  --usage-key USAGE_KEY
                        record field holding the usage sub-object (default:
                        'usage' if present, else top level)
  --turn TURN           turn number as in the log
  --step STEP           step index within the turn
help.describe:
usage: tokenledger describe [-h] [--json] [--quiet]

options:

  --quiet     compact JSON
